summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates installer identity to oastify.com on preinstall
details: The npm package @eforms/forms-api@99.0.0 is a scoped-name dependency-confusion lure with an inflated version number and an empty index.js stub. Its only functionality is a preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script reads os.hostname(), os.userInfo() (username and uid), process.cwd(), process.platform, process.arch, process.version, the CI environment flag, and other host identifiers, and transmits them out-of-band to two hardcoded attacker-controlled subdomains of oastify.com (Interactsh / Burp Collaborator OOB infrastructure) — specifically rpkfvtsptfrhcgbe62qg11ywjnpij6ma1cfpke.oastify.com and f6mk7lyjsuk3u1t49ypp9q2jbah15rtg.oastify.com — via both a DNS lookup of a data-bearing label and an HTTPS GET whose query string carries the collected fields. The combination of a scoped @eforms/* name, implausibly high version (99.0.0 to win internal-vs-public resolution races), empty library surface, and preinstall OOB beacon is the standard shape of an internal-scope dependency-confusion attack. Any build that resolves this scope from the public registry ships internal host identity to the attacker's OOB collector on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
